clearedSpotChecks.check: Code reading: which functions reach _accountDelta and whether each is gated by the transient unlock flag.
clearedSpotChecks.note: Read src/PoolManager.sol:96-114 and 279-384 myself. onlyWhenUnlocked (96-99) guards modifyLiquidity (147), swap (189), donate (258), take (291), settle (300), settleFor (305), clear (310), mint (322) and burn (332). _accountDelta (368-378) is reached only from those and from _settle (364) and _accountPoolBalanceDelta (381-384). unlock sets the flag at 107 and clears it at 113 only after the NonzeroDeltaCount check at 112. sync (279-288) writes only the CurrencyReserves slots (src/libraries/CurrencyReserves.sol tstore at CURRENCY_SLOT and RESERVES_OF_SLOT) and no delta. The flag, the count, the reserves and the per-target deltas all live in transient storage (src/libraries/Lock.sol, NonzeroDeltaCount.sol, CurrencyDelta.sol), and _settle subtracts reserves with checked 0.8.26 arithmetic outside any unchecked block (PoolManager.sol:2 and 360). I found no payout path that skips the flag. The slot constants were not recomputed here because no keccak library is installed.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 3 (L-960, L-976): Arbitrum retryable redeems at Nitro consensus-v61 and its go-ethereum fork. Is the callvalue of a scheduled redeem taken from the ticket escrow in state, and is transient storage empty when the redeem starts?
clearedSpotChecks.note: Fetched nitro consensus-v61 arbos/tx_processor.go: the retry path takes the escrow address from the ticket and calls util.TransferBalance(&escrow, &tx.From, tx.Value, ...) and returns the error (lines 472-477); submission moves tx.RetryValue from tx.From to the escrow with the same transfer (line 320). arbos/util/transfer.go lines 67-76 return ErrInsufficientBalance when the from balance is below the amount before SubBalance. Fetched OffchainLabs/go-ethereum f3a966e core/state_transition.go: CanTransfer check for msg.From at lines 725-727 and StateDB.Prepare at line 737, whose comment says it resets transient storage; core/state/statedb.go line 1599 sets s.transientStorage = newTransientStorage(). The consensus-v61 to f3a966e pin is still unconfirmed, as the research says.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 2 (L-966) on HyperEVM: blocks 45,998,366 to 52,253,230 (the whole history from the deployment block), newest first. Candidates are every transaction with a PoolManager log or an ERC-20 Transfer from or to the PoolManager (eth_getLogs). Every candidate block was traced whole with debug_traceBlockByNumber (callTracer, withLog), so PoolManager frames of non-candidate transactions in those blocks are included. For every PoolManager CALL frame the PoolManager unlock frames above it were tracked. (a) successful take, settle, settleFor, mint, burn, clear, swap, modifyLiquidity or donate frames with no unlock above them; (b) a failed unlock followed by a successful frame of those functions outside a new unlock; also unlock frames with no unlock above them that revert with AlreadyUnlocked (0x5090d6c6), delta frames inside a live unlock that revert with ManagerLocked (0x54e3ca0d), every settle and settleFor output against the transient model of the source, trace status and logs against the mined receipt, and the PoolManager native balance change over the whole range against the native value of all traced frames.
clearedSpotChecks.note: eth_getBalance of the PoolManager 0x12D4Fd9C5DeDd00ab8a0bCe2CF0167bbf94b6B1F on rpc.purroofgroup.com returned 0x0 at block 0x2bde11d (45,998,365) and 0x9d908ef23bc0864f = 11,353,731,831,636,723,279 wei at block 0x31d522e (52,253,230), equal to the figures in the item. Fetched hyper-evm-sync main src/run.rs: the user receipt list is asserted equal at line 264, but the system transaction receipt is asserted only when the block data carries one (lines 235-237, if let Some(receipt)), and the compared Receipt holds only type, success, cumulative gas and logs, so the check does not cover state. The item says system and user receipts are checked alike, which overstates line 236. run.rs also replays HyperCore precompile outputs supplied with the block (set_replay_precompiles, line 158) and patches state only at blocks below 1,531,367 (fix_mainnet_state_diff, lines 61-96), far before the deployment block. The reth/v0.1.0 endpoints are more likely nanoreth builds than hyper-evm-sync; nanoreth nb-20261125-2 src/node/evm/executor.rs lines 323-337 also check system transaction receipts against a hash when the block carries one. The conclusion of the item, no PoolManager native flow outside traced frames, rests on the wei-exact balance reconciliation and holds.
